name: Beautify web landing auth page
description: Redesign the default web app landing/auth page to improve readability and visual hierarchy on first load. Keep the shared auth flow and translations intact, but make the page easier to scan, less visually overwhelming, and more polished across desktop and mobile. Validate the result with the repo-required pnpm ai pipeline after changes.
result: Redesigned the web app's default auth landing page to improve readability and reduce visual noise. Updated the shared auth shell with a calmer editorial layout, refined the supporting panel and language switcher, tightened provider buttons, and refreshed form card/input styling. Verified by loading http://localhost:5173/ in browser automation, confirming the auth screen content renders cleanly without oversized provider graphics, and running pnpm ai successfully.

name: Use generated PokeAPI types
description: Update the shared ORPC PokeAPI fetch to use the existing openapi-typescript generated definitions in packages/shared/src/@types/poke-api.d.ts instead of manually duplicating the fetched payload shape. Keep the implementation simple and validate with pnpm ai after the change.
result: Replaced the duplicated manual PokeAPI response schema in packages/shared/src/orpc/router.ts with the existing openapi-typescript generated response type from packages/shared/src/@types/poke-api.d.ts. Added a narrow runtime type guard so the fetched JSON can be safely narrowed from unknown before mapping it into the ORPC response schema. Verification: pnpm exec tsgo --noEmit -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json passed and pnpm ai passed.

name: Use openapi-fetch for PokeAPI
description: Replace the raw PokeAPI fetch in packages/shared/src/orpc/router.ts with openapi-fetch using the existing generated OpenAPI types in packages/shared/src/@types/poke-api.d.ts. Validate the external response with a Zod schema instead of the current manual type guard. Keep the ORPC response shape unchanged and validate with pnpm ai.
result: Replaced the raw PokeAPI fetch in packages/shared/src/orpc/router.ts with openapi-fetch using the generated OpenAPI paths from packages/shared/src/@types/poke-api.d.ts. Removed the manual type guard and now validate the external response payload with a Zod schema before mapping it into the ORPC response schema. Verification: pnpm exec tsgo --noEmit -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json passed and pnpm ai passed.

name: Refactor web app composition
description: Refactor clients/web/src/app.tsx to separate page orchestration, translated copy construction, and aside UI into focused modules/components. Keep App as a thin composition layer, move translation-heavy copy building behind dedicated helpers/hooks, and extract the large aside sections into reusable components while preserving behavior. Verify with pnpm ai.
result: Refactored clients/web/src/app.tsx into a thin composition layer backed by a dedicated auth page controller hook and extracted page-level components for the form panel and aside stack. Moved translation-heavy form copy and aside rendering out of App so the root component now mainly shows layout structure and wiring. Verification: get_errors reported no issues in the touched files; web-only TypeScript build persisted exit code 0 in .tmp/web-typecheck.exit; pnpm ai was executed and failed in fallow with an existing unused dependency report for shared in clients/web/package.json, which is outside this refactor.

name: Add auth Storybook stories
description: Create Storybook stories for the auth package's exported UI components and ensure the central storybook-base package discovers and renders them. Cover AuthLayout, AuthProviderButton, SignInForm, and SignUpForm with representative states and keep the stories compatible with the repo's existing Vite aliases and styling. Validate with Storybook build or equivalent plus pnpm ai.
result: Added Storybook support for the auth package by registering packages/auth/src in storybook-base discovery and creating stories for AuthLayout, AuthProviderButton, AuthFormCard/AuthTextField, SignInForm, and SignUpForm. Verified Storybook discovery with pnpm --filter storybook-base build-storybook and validated the full repo with pnpm ai successfully.

name: Add first ORPC client-server slice
description: Implement the simplest clean oRPC path between the web app and the API server. Define a shared router that the server mounts through the Hono adapter and the web app consumes through the oRPC fetch client. For the initial procedure, have the backend call a small external service and return a compact typed payload to the web app. Keep the implementation minimal, monorepo-friendly, and easy to review later. Acceptance criteria: one shared oRPC surface exists, the API serves it, the web app calls it successfully, and validation passes with pnpm ai.
result: Implemented a first end-to-end oRPC slice for web-to-server communication. Added a shared workspace router and client factory in packages/shared, mounted the router in the Hono API under /rpc, and updated the web app to call the API through oRPC and display a small typed PokeAPI response. Verification: pnpm exec tsgo --noEmit -p servers/api/tsconfig.json passed, pnpm exec tsgo --noEmit -p clients/web/tsconfig.json passed, pnpm exec tsgo --noEmit -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json passed, and pnpm ai passed.
